missing.title: That order is not here any more
missing.text: It may have been deleted with the account. Open it again from the orders list.

readOnly.title: An admin reads an order; the stall moves it.
readOnly.text: Every button that changes a state lives on the stall's own screen, so nothing here can put an order into the wrong state.

items.title: Items
items.note: Prices are what the stall charged when the order was placed. No money moves through MarketLink; the customer pays at the stall.

history.title: Every state it has been in
history.note: Every status change is recorded with who made it. This is the record an admin reads when a customer and a stall disagree about what happened.

noButtons.title: Why there are no buttons
noButtons.text: An order belongs to one stall and one customer. The stall has the transitions and the customer the cancel before cutoff; an admin is not in that list, so this screen reads and does not touch.
